title: gaultheria caryophylloides var. longipes
intro: Gaultheria caryophylloides var. longipes, commonly known as Mountain Tea, is a plant species that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae) and is native to the Himalayan region. The health benefits of Mountain Tea include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Tea include its analgesic, expectorant, and emetic properties, which can help to relieve pain, cough, and vomiting. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Tea include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
